breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between specifying Dirichlet conditions on all four boundaries and also specifying periodic boundary conditions. The generated specification correctly instructs to apply the Dirichlet conditions and explicitly states to ignore the periodic condition, which aligns with the ground truth's removal of the contradictory periodic instruction.
